title: Work Triage Scanner
key_insight: A heuristic-only triage classifier (lib/triage.ts) classifies all synced work items into active/queued/blocked/stale/done/abandoned using source-system dates from rawData. Council constraint: classification reason always shown, no person-level grouping, external URL always available.
alternatives_considered: Decision Ledger CRUD as next phase
rejected_reason: LLM not wired; heuristics on date gaps and status are sufficient and transparent
Council deliberation determined triage addresses the real problem: 387 items with unknown signal-to-noise ratio
